core_obligations: Full first-order/formal pair definitions and holomorphic differential-operator Gamma action.
Full Proposition2.7 and Corollary3.1 weight transport, Lemma2.8 vanishing, Theorem3.12 lifting and Theorem4.3 existence.

proof_roadmap: Construct one homogeneous coefficient of the logarithmic section at a time; quadratic condition becomes third-derivative cocycle equation.
Use full BCH cancellation lemma and cohomology vanishing to solve and integrate; lift back to all weights.
difficulty_reason: The retained author proof performs a multivariable nonlinear BCH recursion: isolates each first unsolved homogeneous coefficient, proves via lower-order Lie-polynomial cancellation that its third derivative is a cocycle, solves its cohomological obstruction and integrates to a compatible formal section while controlling polynomial cocycle coefficients. Equivariant weight transport then treats all weights. This construction is a nonroutine current core beyond merely quoting section existence.
difficulty_assessment_limits: Material-based H2 only; no independent correctness certification.
